title: Progressive Text Display
description: A simple datapack API to display text to players progressively
body:
# Progressive Text Display

This is a simple datapack API allowing you to display text above the hotbar using the actionbar title.

# How to use:

Set the delay for new characters to appear using:
`scoreboard players set !delay counter <time in ticks>`
(defaults to 1)

Set the text to be displayed using 
`/function progressive_text:set_string {"string":"Hello World!"}`
